scope.quality: Teacher-forced token-weighted ΔNLL/KL against the native reference; no generated-task success measured.
scope.latency: Diagnostic decode/model timing; affinity-before/after arithmetic mean is the timing comparator, not a confidence interval.
scope.io: Demand PROBE_IO totals and ALL ORIGINAL_DEADLINE pread footers are separate, then added. Requested bytes count logical reads, not physical disk traffic.
scope.staging: logical_requested counts admitted staging payloads; pread_requested/returned are actual worker read counters. Peaks are maxima, not sums.
scope.routes: Route substitution counters precede deadline promotion; do not equate planned skipped bytes with net avoided IO.
